news.title: Saudi Crude Exports Hit Five-Month High as Production Falls to Record Low

Production was 8.135 million bpd in July and 6.560 million bpd in May. Exports were 4.125 million bpd in July. In March, they were 4.974 million bpd, JODI data showed in May. news.title: U.S. refineries have been running at very high rates in 2026

analysis.rationale: Exceptionally high refinery utilization indicates robust intake and demand for crude oil feedstock, exerting upward pressure on crude prices.
